To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
we successfully produced a CEA 95 scFv in E. coli, and that the scFv retained its immunoreactivity.

the anti-NCA- 95 scFv was expressed in a prokaryaotic expression vector that contained Sfi I and a Not I site, and that this scFv had the same affinity and immunoreactivity as the intact CEA 79 monoclonal antibody.
the CEA 79 anti-NCA- 95 scFv antibody was successfully constructed and expressed as a soluble protein in a prokariotic expression vector.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the construction and expression of a scFv molecule of the CEA 79 monoclonal antibody.
the construction of a CEA 95 scFv molecule in an E. coli expression vector modified to have Sfi I and Nott I sites.
the expression of the CEA 79 anti-NCA- 95 scFv in a pRSET expression vector modified to allow the insertion of the Sfi I/ Not I digested scFv gene.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the refolded Cea 79 scFvs were functionally active and could potentially be used in the same applications as the original Cea 79 antibody.
the CEA 79 anti-NCA- 95 scFv was successfully expressed and refolded and that this scFv retains its original immunoreactivity.
the scFv of CEA 95 can be produced in a soluble form in a prokariotic expression vector modified with a Sfi I/ Not I site.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the Sfi I/ Not I expression vector can be used for the expression of scFv in a prokareotic expression vector.
the Sfi I/ Not I modified expression vector is an efficient tool for the production of CEA 95 scFv and similar scFv molecules.
the pRSET scFv expression vector can be used to produce a soluble CEA 79 anti-NCA-85 scFv in E. coli.
The main takeaway from our work is that
a Sfi I/ Not I modified expression vector can be used to express a scFv antibody in E. coli.
the Sfi I/ Not I modified expression vector can be used to express other scFv molecules in a prokaryaotic expression system.

the Sfi I/ Not I expression vector is a good tool for the expression of scFv in prokaryotic systems and the CEA 79 anti-NCA- 95 scFv molecule is a good candidate for use as an imaging agent for the detection of bone marrow metastasis in cancer patients.
